messages:
sahil: Ran a regional sweep for onboarding redwood-13b-v1 (q8) to validate kernel tradeoffs. Summary attached below. Asking: should we flip default kernel policy for H100 pools to prefer FlashAttention v3?

sahil: Test matrix: H100 (us-west-2), A100 (us-east-1), H100 (eu-west-1). Sequence lengths: 64, 256, 1024. Workload: mix of chat+completion traces from prod-sim. 10k samples each.

sahil: Key numbers (p50/p95 latency ms) - short table from the run: 
```
GPU   kernel      seq64    seq256   seq1024   tps(64)
H100  flashv3     12 / 28  18 / 46  45 / 110  210
H100  triton-cu   14 / 36  22 / 60  55 / 140  190
A100  triton-cu   15 / 40  24 / 68  70 / 180  160
A100  vendor-lib  20 / 60  30 / 90  80 / 210  140
```

sahil: Observations: flashv3 gives consistent p50/p95 improvements on H100 for seq>=256 and best throughput for short seqs as well. Triton-cu is closer on seq64 but trails on long sequences. Vendor lib (nv) lags on throughput but sometimes lower memory footprint for 1024.

maria: Nice. Did you run quality checks after q8 quant? Any end-to-end regressions?

sahil: ran eval-suite v3 on 5k prompts: ~0.6% BLEU-like drop on code tasks, 0.2% on general chat. Within our regression alert thresholds but flagged. I attached diffs.

alex: Could be quantization noise. Did you verify KV-cache correctness across kernels? Any mismatch in output tokens ordering?

sahil: KV cache validated — bit-identical for fp16 paths, small drift for q8 as expected across kernels but no token reorder issues.

jen: From ops POV we can do regional kernel policy: prefer flashv3 on H100 pools in us-west-2 and eu-west-1, keep triton-cu default on A100. Add hysteresis so we only switch if p95 improves by >10% and tps by >5%.

alex: Also add a short-seq heuristic: for seq<=64 prefer triton-cu fallback if latency delta < 10% (helps cold-starts we've seen).

gpu-bench-bot: Artifact uploaded: https://bench.artifacts/redwood/1904321987/sweep.tar.gz (contains raw csv + perf plots).

tom: Cost check: H100 flashv3 run improved tokens/sec by ~12% -> estimated 8% cost reduction on steady workloads after accounting for autoscale. Need finance signoff for changing billing-propagated pool params.

maria: For rollout: canary 5% traffic -> monitor eval metrics and runtime quality checks for 48h. If any regression >1% on our evals, auto rollback.

jen: Agreed. I'll add a canary rollout config (canary:5%, duration:48h, rollback_on_quality:true).

alex: One more: make sure to include kernel metadata in request traces so we can correlate failures to kernel flavor.

sahil: OK. Plan: implement policy change in staging with hysteresis + short-seq fallback, run canary in us-west-2 H100 pools. If green and finance ok, promote to production next week. I'll post a follow-up when canary starts.

maria: :thumbsup:

tom: add a note in capacity-sizing doc about delta (we'll need ~6% fewer H100 nodes at 90th percentile with flashv3).

sahil: thanks all, starting the staging rollout now.
